'Never continue spending after cancellation' is now MET and this REFUTES reports/17-audit.md F-2: onAbort is wired at chat-assistant.service.ts:270-274 and ai-gateway-stream.helper.ts:163, and onFinish is guarded by `if (resolved) return` at :283.
criteria.blocker: 'never duplicate a paid request' does not hold. The reservation-idempotency mechanism was built (aiReservationIdempotencyKey at src/modules/ai/core/streaming/ai-request-abort.ts:73, threaded to all 5 ledger.reserve sites: chat-assistant.service.ts:126, kb-rag.service.ts:165, ai-gateway-embed.helper.ts:111, ai-gateway-stream.helper.ts:117, ai-gateway-credit.helper.ts:119) but it is CALLER-OPT-IN: ai-request-abort.ts:79 returns undefined whenever the request carried no Idempotency-Key header, and the interface comment at :22 says so outright ('Absent on most requests'). Nothing requires the header — `grep -rn '@Idempotent' src/modules/ai` returns 1 hit and it is a comment (ai-request-abort.ts:70), and check:idempotent-commands passes only because its scope is 11 handlers out of 547 controllers (/tmp/beg-check_idempotent-commands.log), none of them AI. Only 7 of 124 invocations pass `dedupe: true` (grep, specs excluded). A proxy or mobile client that retries a POST the backend already completed therefore reserves again, calls the provider again and settles again.
